Defined compensation after unopened destination reverses source withdrawal

All five personas exercised; actual authenticated event count 4 through protected read; correlated read and raw snapshots remain discoverable

One real deposit committed with HTTP200/success before its browser reply was aborted; client failure remains visible alongside the actual balance and one ledger entry; no retry; expanded request history stays within 320/390px layouts and its labelled region scrolls by keyboard

documentationFindings.disposition: Node.js/npm are now explicit capture prerequisites. SDK, PowerShell and Docker alone did not satisfy the documented npm/node commands.

README now promises manifest reporting for journey/assertion failures after browser setup, and states missing modules, invalid source IDs and browser setup failures may produce stderr only. The completed On/Off evidence is unchanged.

claimReview: Every packaged README, review, manifest, inventory, counter, process, result, source, history and baseline document was read. The existing tested capture.cjs was reviewed across the source iterations and its unchanged final source is bound by the complete source ledger.

All eight source/runtime finding dispositions are RESOLVED and all 27 evidence links exist. Their retained assertions, actual before/after scope and static versus runtime limits match the referenced evidence.

Source31 canonical executed counters are 3461 core, 280 sample, L2 15 and L3 20. Doctor is READY only. The 3 zero-test facade reports are excluded. Historical aggregate failures are distinct from current results.
Mutation was not run, the Go process output was bounded/truncated, and raw report hashes are distinguished from portable UTF-8/LF text hashes.

All 153 final console/network records remain disclosed; exact generic console pairing is inferred because location/phase are absent. The 19 incomplete contrast targets are specific manually measured dispositions, not a broad accessibility certification.

Baseline source is parent discovery/launch checkpoint provenance; source/version/time/exact command were not instrumented by the baseline helper. The desktop and phone populated views are different projection moments.

All 76 collective source ledger paths remain unchanged. This reviewer verified their fingerprints and reviewed the complete new evidence bundle, while the independent architecture and CoV reviewers own complete production-file review.

Independent full runtime used fresh unique explicit IDs and actual commands, and did not mutate default accounts or high-value/global-queue state. Investigation contrast probe read actual current global data without a command.
